note: Versioned SLO objects. Every threshold has its unit; request conditions are evaluated together per request; global constraints are evaluated separately. Declared 2026-11-15, before any harness result; a change is a new version, never an edit after results.

slos.origin: docs/DECISIONS.md line 15 (Service SLO, declared 14 Nov 2026): per request TTFT <= 2 s (1,000-token prompts) and TPOT <= 50 ms; distribution: p99 time between tokens <= 100 ms. The historical open-loop runs applied only the two request limits (runbook/serving_openloop.sh); this object applies all three.

request_predicate.tpot_metric: tpot_native_ms: (E2EL - TTFT) / (N - 1) for N > 1; 0 for a one-token response (pinned InferenceX convention)

global_constraints.p99_token_gap_note: exact token gaps; when per-chunk token counts are unknown the limit is unmeasurable (chunk gaps are not substituted)

slos.eligibility: measured requests of the run (warmup excluded); finite cohort over the cohort duration, sustained lane inside the steady window
slos.scope_note: TTFT limit stated for 1,000-token prompts; for 8,192-token prompts slo-batch-v1 is reported alongside

slos.origin: project addition declared 2026-11-15 before any harness result (not in docs/DECISIONS.md): long prompts and throughput-oriented serving

global_constraints.p99_token_gap_note: exact token gaps; when per-chunk token counts are unknown the limit is unmeasurable (chunk gaps are not substituted)

slos.origin: LeapQuant single-GPU benchmark execution prompt (updated 15 Nov 2026, adopted by Asif 16 Nov ~01:30 UTC), section 5, 'suggested local service policy for the short-context workload': request TTFT <= 2 s and average request TPOT <= 50 ms, at least 95% joint attainment over offered logical requests, at least 99% complete success; p99 token/chunk gap recorded separately. Declared before any run of the single-gpu campaign (lq-h100-2026-11-sg). No documented product policy governs the campaign; v1 (which also gated p99 token gap <= 100 ms and error rate <= 1% of attempted requests) remains the policy of record for jobs 116-124 and is reported alongside for them. Our proposed service gates, not industry thresholds.

request_predicate.tpot_metric: tpot_native_ms: (E2EL - TTFT) / (N - 1) for N > 1; 0 for a one-token response (pinned InferenceX convention)

global_constraints.denominator_note: finite cohort: the requests the profile offers (num_prompts = 10C, warm-up excluded); sustained lane: logical requests started inside the steady window; a retry is the same logical request
global_constraints.p99_token_gap_note: recorded separately, not a gate; observed chunk gaps are reported when per-chunk token counts are unknown (never fabricated per-token times)

slos.eligibility: measured requests of the run (warmup excluded); finite cohort over the cohort duration, sustained lane inside the steady window

units.tpot_ms_max: ms per output token (average over the request)

slos.scope_note: short-context workload (1k/1k); a long-prompt profile would need its own declared policy
